segments.t: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς が前置）

segments.t: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
segments.note: ταπεινοφροσύνη を「lowliness and humility」と二語で訳す

segments.t: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
segments.note: 繋辞の「There is」は英語の補い

segments.t: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
segments.note: 繋辞は英語の補い

segments.t: one God and Father of all,
who is over all and through all
and in us all.
segments.note: WEB は「in us all」と訳す。「us」はビザンティン本文（ἡμῖν）の影響で、ギリシャ語本文は ἐν πᾶσιν のみ

segments.t: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but
that he also
first
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「first」（πρῶτον）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: descended into the lower parts of the earth?
He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
segments.note: μὲν・δὲ は英語に現れない。「to be」は英語の補い

segments.t: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
segments.note: 主語の「we」は καταντήσωμεν に含まれる

segments.t: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
segments.note: κλυδωνιζόμενοι を「tossed back and forth」とほぐす

segments.t: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え。τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ σώματος ποιεῖται を「makes the body increase」とほぐす

segments.t: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
segments.note: 「the rest of」は τὰ ἔθνη のほぐし

segments.t: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
segments.note: ἀπηλγηκότες を「having become callous」と訳す

segments.t: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
segments.note: εἴ γε を「if indeed」と訳す

segments.t: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
segments.note: 主語は21節から続く

segments.t: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
segments.note: 主語は21節から続く

segments.t: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
segments.note: τὸν κατὰ θεὸν κτισθέντα を「who in the likeness of God has been created」とほぐす

segments.t: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
and don’t give place to the devil.
segments.note: 文頭の「and」は接続の補い

segments.t: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
segments.note: ἐργαζόμενος ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν τὸ ἀγαθόν を「labor, producing with his hands something that is good」とほぐす

segments.t: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
segments.note: πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χρείας を「for building others up as the need may be」とほぐす

segments.t: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
And be kind to one another,
segments.note: 文頭の「And」は接続の補い

segments.t: tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
segments.note: ἑαυτοῖς を「each other」と訳す
